scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0125; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target-bearing learner lines ‘Yes. This information is for you.’ and ‘This information is for Maya too.’ are grammatical and natural; all English distractors were individually checked for naturalness.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps information to «اطلاعات» and preserves the intended meaning across dialogue and activities.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: A04 and A05 use grammatical, natural alternatives with explicit model audit evidence and a concrete semantic contrast for every wrong option.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner production stays short and controlled; one lexical target is scored and the familiar present-be affirmative frame is recycled explicitly.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the recipient while preserving the same bounded sense of information.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, construction, scenario, learner turns, choices, grammar recycling, and final retrieval align to the same objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image/photo/visual is claimed. Listening and dialogue playback reference only T01–T04, all marked audioRequired=true.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded lexical sense defined for this Lesson is reviewed.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
